# Security Policy

## Reporting Vulnerabilities
If you discover a security vulnerability within this repository, please send an email to the project maintainer at [Zygros@domain.com]. We take all security vulnerabilities seriously and appreciate your responsible reporting.

### Security Best Practices
- Keep your dependencies up to date.
- Use strong, unique passwords for all accounts.
- Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) where possible.
- Regularly audit your code for vulnerabilities.
- Follow secure coding practices to prevent common vulnerabilities (e.g., XSS, SQL injection).

## Code of Conduct
We expect everyone to follow our [Code of Conduct](link_to_code_of_conduct) regarding security disclosures. Thank you for helping keep our community safe!
